purpose: Explicit inventory of structured diagnostic flows versus the current fault library. A documented gap is not treated as covered.
matchingRule: A flow is covered only when at least one fault has the same equipmentType and includes the same symptom ID, or a reviewed explicit mapping is added here. No implicit aliases.

pump|low_flow.note: The current mapping to pump-cavitation is not a defensible exact match: low flow is a symptom with multiple competing causes. The diagnostic engine contains broad suction/supply and flow-path prompts, but the fault-library coverage must not be marked complete until each pump cause has an explicit reviewed mapping and discriminating evidence.

conveyor|tracking.note: The tracking symptom ID is not present in the current fault library. Do not add it as covered until symptom schema/content is reviewed.

thermal|overheat.note: No exact equipmentType=thermal record found. Review whether this is intended as an equipment type or a diagnostic domain.
